core_obligations: Resolve the sheaf (proof lines 7242-7243): choose an injective resolution F -> I^bullet of F on X_etale.

Produce the short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 7243-7262): show that 0 -> f_* I^bullet -> a_* I^bullet|_U direct sum b_* I^bullet|_V -> c_* I^bullet|_{U cap V} -> 0 is short exact, by checking on sections over each W in Y_etale the sequence 0 -> I^n(W x_Y X) -> I^n(W x_Y U) direct sum I^n(W x_Y V) -> I^n(W x_Y (U cap V)) -> 0, which the author cites as shown in the proof of the Mayer-Vietoris lemma.

Identify the restricted complexes (proof lines 7263-7265): I^bullet|_U, I^bullet|_V and I^bullet|_{U cap V} are injective resolutions of the respective restrictions of F, so their cohomology sheaves are the corresponding higher direct images.
Conclude (proof lines 7263-7265): taking cohomology sheaves of the short exact sequence of complexes yields the long exact sequence of the statement, functorial because the construction is.
proof_roadmap: Resolve F by injectives on X_etale.
Use the Mayer-Vietoris short exactness of section groups over W x_Y X, W x_Y U, W x_Y V, W x_Y (U cap V) to get a short exact sequence of complexes of sheaves on Y_etale.
Note the restricted complexes are injective resolutions of the restrictions of F.
Take cohomology sheaves to obtain the long exact sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the relative Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence for the higher direct images along f : X -> Y when X is the union of two open subschemes U and V (statement lines 7222-7239). The proof is a short-exactness argument on complexes: after resolving F injectively on X_etale, one has to see that the complex-level sequence 0 -> f_* I^bullet -> a_* I^bullet|_U direct sum b_* I^bullet|_V -> c_* I^bullet|_{U cap V} -> 0 is short exact, which the author does by evaluating on sections over each object W of Y_etale, where the sequence becomes the Mayer-Vietoris sequence of the fibre products W x_Y X, W x_Y U, W x_Y V, W x_Y (U cap V) (proof lines 7252-7262). The remaining step is to recognise the restricted complexes as injective resolutions (proof lines 7263-7265), which is what converts cohomology sheaves into higher direct images of the restrictions. The claim is H2: one exactness check on sections plus one standard identification.
